title: Architecture-agnostic analysis of partially coherent light with programmable photonics
summary: The precise characterization of the spatial degree of coherence of a radiation field is important for assessing its suitability for specific applications in optical communications, advanced imaging, and quantum information processing. However, measuring the full coherence matrix traditionally requires complex, phase-sensitive interferometric setups that are highly susceptible to noise and difficult to scale on integrated platforms.
